text:
The US Justice Department says an Iran backed militant held in a New York jail helped plot September's failed attack on RAF Fairford, the UK base hosting US bombers.

Prosecutors say he passed coded messages through relatives in Iraq.

🚨 More than 20 explosions have been heard in Kryvyi Rih tonight as Russia keeps striking Ukraine's energy infrastructure.

Power outages are being reported across the city. https://t.co/VnVPs1ddXw

Iran can still produce around 50 ballistic missiles a month, roughly half its prewar output, according to a Western intelligence estimate reported by Bloomberg.

That runs against US claims that Iran's missile capabilities have been badly degraded. https://t.co/5a24cMu4Lw

Senate Republicans have reelected John Thune as their leader, keeping him at the helm of the GOP conference in the next Congress.

He overcame calls from colleagues to delay the vote until the party could reckon with its sweeping midterm losses.

Bernie Sanders will not support Chuck Schumer for another term as Senate Democratic leader, saying voters want new leadership and that the election was about change.

Schumer is pushing back: "I'm confident I will be elected majority leader." https://t.co/zfIpsDAoff

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has asked the UN and the IAEA to condemn a US State Department offer of up to $20 million for information on Iran's nuclear program.

He made the request in a letter to the UN chief and the Security Council.

Tom Emmer keeps his spot in House GOP leadership, beating Texas Rep. August Pfluger to become House Minority Whip in the next Congress.

Republicans are regrouping after the midterms, with Jim Jordan elected minority leader earlier today.

Former MI6 chief Richard Moore says Xi Jinping is watching Ukraine and Iran very carefully.

If Beijing comes to believe the West lacks the will to see off Putin or the Iranian regime, Moore warns, it could lead Xi into "miscalculating over Taiwan."

🚨 The Pentagon has approved a permanent US military base in Poland, according to Poland's defense minister, who called the decision a "green light."

He spoke after War Secretary Pete Hegseth told him the talks were moving in a good direction.

Chinese made tractor trucks have joined the IRGC Aerospace Force logistics fleet, partly over distrust of European Iveco and Mercedes Benz trucks imported via the UAE, Turkey and Oman.

Sitrak, BAIC and Dongfeng trucks appear at one of its missile facilities. https://t.co/HOWXmU3Zo2

IRGC Aerospace Force commander Brigadier General Majid Mousavi addresses personnel flanked by two Fattah 1 medium range ballistic missiles, with a third right behind him.

Two erected Qiam 2/Jihad missiles can also be seen in the background.

https://t.co/R96uQnn4cA

🚨 Rep. Jim Jordan has won the vote to become House Republican minority leader in the 120th Congress.

The longtime Trump ally will lead the GOP fight to win back the House after the midterm defeat, as Speaker Mike Johnson steps aside from leadership.

Iran has carried out 144 attacks on 140 civilian vessels since February 28, sinking 8, according to data compiled by an OSINT613 contributor.

Some ships were hit more than once. Navig8 Messi was struck by IRGC drones in August, repaired, then hit again on November 7.

New footage is said to show the aftermath of today's strike on Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD).

The Houthis named the financial hub among today's targets, along with Riyadh airport. The damage has not been independently confirmed.

https://t.co/PK1HC1EjOH
Israeli forces killed a 14 year old Palestinian boy during a raid in Burqa in the West Bank, while settlers set fire to an industrial area in Beita and assaulted a woman near Hebron.

British counter terrorism police arrested a US Army member near Gloucester on suspicion of spying for Russia.

The 41 year old is held in London under the National Security Act. Two properties are being searched, with MI5, the FBI and the US military on the case.

🚨 A fire broke out on the SPD14D platform in Iran's South Pars gas field minutes ago, and workers are leaving the site.

About 500 million cubic feet of gas has been taken out of production after the incident.

An Israeli airstrike hit a workshop in southern Gaza City tonight, according to Palestinian media.

https://t.co/D7sas1SvV0

A Lebanese source claims the body of former Iraqi MP Ahmed al Alwani was found in an apartment in the Tariq al Jdideh area of Beirut.

The claim has not been independently verified.

https://t.co/rB26MskpDk
Northern Gaza: gunmen from Ashraf al Mansi's Popular Forces militia filmed showing off their strength while chanting "Death to Hamas." https://t.co/VnlghbKzL3
